description.value: Wild Ginger is an Asian fusion restaurant on Main Street in downtown Penticton, serving a broad menu spanning Vietnamese, Thai, and Chinese cuisines including Beef Pho, Pad Thai, Chow Mein, and signature stir-fries. The kitchen caters to dietary needs with gluten-free and vegan adaptations available across most dishes and free tofu substitutions on request. Online ordering and local delivery make it a convenient refuelling option for cyclists passing through the Okanagan.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at wildgingerpenticton.ca loaded successfully and provides strong evidence: the restaurant is active at 340 Main Street, Penticton with phone (236) 422-3039, a full Asian fusion menu, and an online ordering system. The menu header explicitly offers GF and V adaptations with free tofu substitution, and multiple individual items carry those labels. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Asian fusion restaurant with a full menu and online ordering at a confirmed Main Street address in Penticton — a publicly accessible business useful to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Phone (236) 422-3039 and address 340 Main Street sourced from website; OSM record contained no phone or address fields, so contact_confirmed is null for those fields.
